hypotheses.statement: trend persistence: if trend persistence exists, strategy capturing it should survive walk-forward, CPCV, costs, regime

hypotheses.falsify: OOS Sharpe <=0, WFE<0.3, DSR <0.5, or placebo equivalent, or cost BE <5bps
